versions.heading:
Mootness doctrine, public
interest exception to apply, when.
versions.text:
Notwithstanding any other provision of law to the contrary, the public interest exception to the mootness doctrine shall apply to an appeal of a full order of protection which:

(1) Has expired; and

(2) Subjects the person against whom such order is issued to significant collateral consequences by the mere existence of such full order of protection after its expiration.
